name: Rapid Decimation for Direct Volume Rendering
definition: A decimation process that converts a grid of simple hexahedral or tetrahedral cells into a hybrid grid with many-sided cells and non-cell polygons by removing un-important vertices and their associated polygons.
summary: Rapid Decimation reduces polygon counts in hexahedral or tetrahedral grids by removing vertices based on data-value buckets rather than geometric proximity, preserving critical feature boundaries for efficient volume rendering.
